narr: A broad upper level high centered near the 4-Corners region extended to the east coast north of Florida. The eastern portion of the ridge rapidly eroded as an upper level trough dove south across the Great Lakes to the Ohio River Valley. Locally, there was some form of residual frontal boundary draped across the area. The morning local upper air sounding showed ample instability for robust thunderstorm development as well as ample moisture available. That combo along with a boundary for storms to focus on provided the environment for a thunderstorm to produce flash flooding over portions of St. Tammany Parish.
ev: Law enforcement reported in portions of Slidell near Gause Boulevard. A few cars stalled due to driving in high water.
lsr: STREET FLOODING REPORTED IN PORTIONS OF SLIDELL NEAR GAUSE BOULEVARD. A FEW CARS BECAME STALLED OUT WHEN THEY DROVE INTO THE FLOODED STREET.
